verdict.rationale: INPI's own published pages include a section titled "Dépôt de brevet en ligne" (online patent filing), alongside filing pages for trademarks, designs and e-Soleau, so the core filing transaction is documented as available online. The evidence is only page headings, with no detail showing the filing and payment can be completed end-to-end online. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that trademark and design filings are online, a documented end-to-end online filing and payment flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
